description_vi: Trắng sáng nhất — bản đã chốt
notes: Only original-tile exports preserve the full opaque original framing.
Transparent logos are raster cutouts; the surrounding dark tile and broad glow are removed.
Full-bleed icons extend only the outer background; crystal pixels remain unchanged before downsampling.
Adaptive and maskable variants re-center/re-scale the same cutout to keep it inside the safe area.
No SVG or native layered Icon Composer file is claimed.
No image is enlarged beyond the original raster resolution.
